text: In GTA 6, you can rob a store in broad daylight.
In real Miami, something worse actually happened.
Dadeland Mall, one of the busiest shopping centers in the city.
A delivery van pulls up outside a liquor store.
Two men walk in, and seconds later the gunfire starts.
Automatic weapons, in the middle of the afternoon, with shoppers all around.
Two men inside the store were killed.
Police connected the attack to the cocaine trade that was taking over the city,
and the newspapers gave this new kind of killer a name: the Cocaine Cowboys.
That afternoon is part of the real history behind Vice City.
Follow for more real stories behind GTA 6.
